# Confirm cross-origin navigation pauses the assistant safely

## What & Why
The multi-page harness now covers same-origin page changes, but a real application can redirect to another origin. Verify the assistant pauses before scanning or filling after that boundary and never carries page controls across sites.

## Done looks like
- Extend the Chromium harness around browser/application-assist/content.js and artifacts/escape-hatch/tests/assist.spec.ts.
- Navigate the synthetic application to a different origin after a session starts.
- Assert the session is paused, no new-origin fields are filled, and navigation controls remain untouched.
